sentences.text: Lisinopril is used to treat high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Lisinopril tablets, USP, are indicated for the treatment of hypertension in adult patients and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older to lower blood pressure.

sentences.text: It is also used along with other treatment for heart failure.
sentences.quote: Adjunct therapy for heart failure (1.2)

sentences.text: It can be used after a heart attack in people whose condition is stable.
sentences.quote: indicated for the reduction of mortality in treatment of hemodynamically stable patients within 24 hours of acute myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: The label says not to use salt substitutes that have potassium unless the doctor says it is okay.
sentences.quote: Tell patients not to use salt substitutes containing potassium without consulting their physician.

sentences.text: Sweating a lot, dehydration, vomiting, or diarrhea can make blood pressure drop too low.
sentences.quote: Tell patients that excessive perspiration and dehydration may lead to an excessive fall in blood pressure because of reduction in fluid volume.

sentences.text: People with diabetes who take diabetes medicine or insulin should check their blood sugar closely when starting this medicine.
sentences.quote: Tell diabetic patients treated with oral antidiabetic agents or insulin starting an ACE inhibitor to monitor for hypoglycaemia closely, especially during the first month of combined use

sentences.text: In people treated for high blood pressure, common side effects were headache, dizziness, and cough.
sentences.quote: Hypertension: headache, dizziness and cough (6.1)

sentences.text: In people with heart failure, low blood pressure and chest pain were common.
sentences.quote: Heart Failure: hypotension and chest pain (6.1)

sentences.text: Tell the doctor about feeling light-headed, especially in the first few days.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report light-headedness especially during the first few days of therapy.

sentences.text: Report swelling of the face, lips, or tongue, or trouble swallowing or breathing, right away.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report immediately any signs or symptoms suggesting angioedema (swelling of face, extremities, eyes, lips, tongue, difficulty in swallowing or breathing)

sentences.text: If a person faints, talk with the doctor before taking more of this medicine.
sentences.quote: If actual syncope occurs, tell the patient to discontinue the drug until they have consulted with the prescribing physician.

sentences.text: Report signs of infection, like a sore throat or fever, quickly.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report promptly any indication of infection (e.g., sore throat, fever), which may be a sign of leukopenia/neutropenia.

sentences.text: This medicine can harm an unborn baby, so tell a healthcare provider about a pregnancy.
sentences.quote: Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus

sentences.text: The label says older people may be more sensitive to this medicine.
sentences.quote: greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out.

sentences.text: This medicine is used to treat serious heart failure.
sentences.quote: The treatment of NYHA Class III-IV heart failure and reduced ejection fraction to increase survival, manage edema, and to reduce the need for hospitalization for heart failure

sentences.text: It can be added to other medicines to help lower high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Use as an add-on therapy for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.

sentences.text: It is also used for swelling in some adults with liver problems.
sentences.quote: The management of edema in adult patients who are cirrhotic when edema is not responsive to fluid and sodium restrictions

sentences.text: It can be taken with or without food.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone tablets can be taken with or without food, but should be taken consistently with respect to food

sentences.text: Either way is fine, but take it the same way each time.
sentences.quote: but should be taken consistently with respect to food

sentences.text: Avoid potassium supplements and foods high in potassium, including salt substitutes.
sentences.quote: should be advised to avoid potassium supplements and foods containing high levels of potassium, including salt substitutes.

sentences.text: The most common side effect is breast growth in men, called gynecomastia.
sentences.quote: The most common adverse reaction with spironolactone treatment is gynecomastia

sentences.text: Stomach upset, like nausea, vomiting or diarrhea, may happen.
sentences.quote: Digestive: Gastric bleeding, ulceration, gastritis, diarrhea and cramping, nausea, vomiting.

sentences.text: Some people have had dizziness, headache, drowsiness or confusion.
sentences.quote: Nervous system/psychiatric: Lethargy, mental confusion, ataxia, dizziness, headache, drowsiness.

sentences.text: Some people have also had leg cramps.
sentences.quote: Musculoskeletal : Leg cramps.

sentences.text: This medicine can make the potassium level in the blood too high.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone can cause hyperkalemia.

sentences.text: This risk is greater with kidney problems or with salt substitutes that contain potassium.
sentences.quote: This risk is increased by impaired renal function or concomitant potassium supplementation, potassium-containing salt substitutes

sentences.text: Losing too much fluid can cause dehydration, low blood pressure and worse kidney function.
sentences.quote: Excessive diuresis may cause symptomatic dehydration, hypotension and worsening renal function

sentences.text: Older adults are more likely to have weaker kidneys, so their kidney function should be checked.
sentences.quote: Because elderly patients are more likely to have decreased renal function, monitor renal function.

sentences.text: Warfarin helps prevent and treat blood clots in the veins and lungs.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and its extension, pulmonary embolism (PE)

sentences.text: It is also used for clot problems linked to atrial fibrillation or a heart valve replacement.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of thromboembolic complications associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) and/or cardiac valve replacement.

sentences.text: After a heart attack, it helps lower the risk of death, another heart attack, and clots such as stroke.
sentences.quote: Reduction in the risk of death, recurrent myocardial infarction (MI), and thromboembolic events such as stroke or systemic embolization after myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: Take it exactly the way the doctor prescribed.
sentences.quote: Take warfarin sodium exactly as prescribed.

sentences.text: If a dose is missed, the label says to call the healthcare provider.
sentences.quote: If you miss a dose of warfarin sodium, call your healthcare provider.

sentences.text: The label says to take a missed dose as soon as possible on the same day.
sentences.quote: Take the dose as soon as possible on the same day.

sentences.text: Regular blood tests and visits with the healthcare provider are needed.
sentences.quote: You must have regular blood tests and visits with your healthcare provider to monitor your condition.

sentences.text: The most common side effect is bleeding, which can be serious or even fatal.
sentences.quote: Most common adverse reactions to warfarin sodium are fatal and nonfatal hemorrhage from any tissue or organ.

sentences.text: Stomach upsets can happen, such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and belly pain.
sentences.quote: Gastrointestinal disorders: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, taste perversion, abdominal pain, flatulence, bloating

sentences.text: Skin problems such as rash, itching, or hair loss can also happen.
sentences.quote: Skin disorders: rash, dermatitis (including bullous eruptions), pruritus, alopecia

sentences.text: Warfarin can cause major or deadly bleeding.
sentences.quote: Warfarin sodium can cause major or fatal bleeding

sentences.text: Tell the doctor right away about any unusual bleeding or symptoms.
sentences.quote: Notify their physician immediately if any unusual bleeding or symptoms occur.

sentences.text: Call the doctor right away if the skin is painful and discolored, like a purple bruise-like rash.
sentences.quote: Immediately contact their physician when experiencing pain and discoloration of the skin (a purple bruise like rash)

sentences.text: Older adults need closer checks for bleeding when they have a higher risk of bleeding.
sentences.quote: Conduct more frequent monitoring for bleeding with administration of warfarin sodium to elderly patients in any situation or with any physical condition where added risk of hemorrhage is present.

sentences.text: Sertraline is a type of medicine called an SSRI (selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor).
sentences.quote: Sertraline hydrochloride tablets are a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) indicated for the treatment of

sentences.text: It is used to treat depression, obsessive-compulsive disorder, panic disorder, PTSD, and social anxiety disorder.
sentences.quote: Major depressive disorder (MDD) Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) Panic disorder (PD) Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) Social anxiety disorder (SAD)

sentences.text: It is also used to treat premenstrual dysphoric disorder.
sentences.quote: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD)

sentences.text: When possible, the label says to lower the dose slowly, step by step, instead of stopping it all at once.
sentences.quote: Gradually reduce the dosage rather than stopping sertraline hydrochloride tablets abruptly whenever possible.

sentences.text: Do not stop it without first talking to the healthcare provider.
sentences.quote: Do not stop sertraline hydrochloride tablets without first talking to your healthcare provider.

sentences.text: Tell the healthcare provider about any prescription or over-the-counter medicines that raise the risk of bleeding.
sentences.quote: Advise patients to inform their health care providers if they are taking or planning to take any prescription or over-the-counter medications that increase the risk of bleeding

sentences.text: Common side effects include nausea, loose stools, tremor, upset stomach, less appetite, sweating, and lower sex drive.
sentences.quote: nausea, diarrhea/loose stool, tremor, dyspepsia, decreased appetite, hyperhidrosis, ejaculation failure, and decreased libido

sentences.text: It may cause sexual problems in both men and women.
sentences.quote: Advise patients that use of sertraline hydrochloride may cause symptoms of sexual dysfunction in both male and female patients.

sentences.text: Stopping too quickly may cause anxiety, irritability, mood changes, restlessness, or changes in sleep.
sentences.quote: Stopping sertraline hydrochloride tablets too quickly may cause serious symptoms including: anxiety, irritability, high or low mood, feeling restless or changes in sleep habits

sentences.text: In short-term studies, antidepressants raised the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in children and young adults.
sentences.quote: Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in pediatric and young adult patients in short-term studies.

sentences.text: If signs of serotonin syndrome appear, contact the healthcare provider or go to the emergency room.
sentences.quote: Patients should contact their health care provider or report to the emergency room if they experience signs or symptoms of serotonin syndrome

sentences.text: Aspirin, NSAIDs, warfarin, and other blood thinners may add to the bleeding risk.
sentences.quote: Concomitant use of aspirin, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), other antiplatelet drugs, warfarin, and other anticoagulants may add to this risk.

sentences.text: Older adults may have a greater risk of low sodium in the blood.
sentences.quote: SNRIs and SSRIs, including sertraline hydrochloride, have been associated with cases of clinically significant hyponatremia in elderly patients, who may be at greater risk for this adverse reaction

sentences.text: This medicine is used with diet and exercise to help control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
sentences.quote: indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus

sentences.text: It is used with diet and exercise to help control blood sugar in adults and children 10 and older who have type 2 diabetes.
sentences.quote: indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

sentences.text: Swallow the tablets whole, and never crush, cut, or chew them.
sentences.quote: Swallow metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets whole and never crush, cut or chew.

sentences.text: It is taken with the evening meal.
sentences.quote: with the evening meal

sentences.text: If a dose is missed, do not take two doses on the same day.
sentences.quote: instruct patients not to take two doses the same day and to resume their usual dose

sentences.text: The label says you may sometimes see a soft lump in the stool that looks like the tablet.
sentences.quote: the inactive ingredients may occasionally be eliminated in the feces as a soft mass that may resemble the original tablet

sentences.text: The most common side effects are diarrhea, nausea or vomiting, gas, weakness, indigestion, belly discomfort, and headache.
sentences.quote: the most common adverse reactions (> 5.0%) are diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, flatulence, asthenia, indigestion, abdominal discomfort, and headache.

sentences.text: Some people may also have constipation, dizziness, or a change in taste.
sentences.quote: abdominal pain, constipation, distention abdomen, dyspepsia/heartburn, flatulence, dizziness, headache, upper respiratory infection, taste disturbance

sentences.text: This medicine can cause a serious problem called lactic acidosis, which has led to death in some cases.
sentences.quote: Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acidosis have resulted in death, hypothermia, hypotension, and resistant bradyarrhythmias.

sentences.text: The warning signs can be mild and easy to miss, like feeling weak, muscle pain, trouble breathing, or unusual sleepiness.
sentences.quote: The onset of metformin-associated lactic acidosis is often subtle, accompanied only by nonspecific symptoms such as malaise, myalgias, respiratory distress, somnolence, and abdominal pain.

sentences.text: The label says to stop the medicine and tell the healthcare provider right away if fast breathing, muscle pain, or unusual sleepiness happens without a clear reason.
sentences.quote: Advise patients to discontinue metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets immediately and to promptly notify their healthcare provider if unexplained hyperventilation, myalgias, malaise, unusual somnolence or other nonspecific symptoms occur.

sentences.text: Drinking a lot of alcohol raises the risk, so the label warns against it.
sentences.quote: Patients should be warned against excessive alcohol intake while receiving metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets.

sentences.text: Older adults need their kidneys checked more often.
sentences.quote: Assess renal function more frequently in elderly patients

explanations.text: The lisinopril label says that using it with diabetes medicines (including oral ones) may increase the blood-sugar-lowering effect. This can raise the risk of low blood sugar.
explanations.quote: Concomitant administration of lisinopril and antidiabetic medicines (insulins, oral hypoglycemic agents) may cause an increased blood-glucose-lowering effect with risk of hypoglycemia.

explanations.text: The lisinopril label says potassium-sparing diuretics like spironolactone can raise the risk of high potassium. It says potassium in the blood should be checked often if they are used together.
explanations.quote: Potassium-sparing diuretics (spironolactone, amiloride, triamterene, and others) can increase the risk of hyperkalemia.

explanations.text: The spironolactone label lists ACE inhibitors among drugs that can raise potassium, and using such drugs together may lead to severe high potassium. It says to check potassium levels when ACE inhibitor therapy is changed.
explanations.quote: Check serum potassium levels when ACE inhibitor or ARB therapy is altered in patients receiving spironolactone.

explanations.text: The sertraline label names warfarin as a protein-bound drug. It says to watch for side effects when the two are used together.
explanations.quote: Monitor for adverse reactions and reduce dosage of sertraline hydrochloride or other protein-bound drugs (e.g., warfarin) as warranted.

explanations.text: The warfarin label lists sertraline among drugs that can increase the risk of bleeding when used with warfarin. It says patients taking both should be closely monitored.
explanations.quote: Because bleeding risk is increased when these drugs are used concomitantly with warfarin, closely monitor patients receiving any such drug with warfarin.
